strings.name: Recep Tayyip Erdoğan
strings.summary: Born in Istanbul, Erdoğan rose from local politics and the mayoralty, cofounded the AKP, became prime minister in 2003 and president in 2014. He advanced presidential rule and regional diplomacy across the Middle East, Europe and Black Sea. Early growth and infrastructure coexisted with concentrated power and pressure on media and opposition; post-2016 coup purges deepened rights concerns.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through 13 November 2026; not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: Long led Türkiye, drove political-system transformation and participated in Middle Eastern, European and Black Sea security affairs, influencing cross-regional relations.
strings.facts.f1.label: Birthplace
strings.facts.f2.label: Education
strings.facts.f2.value: Imam Hatip high school (1973); official biography reports an economics and administration diploma from Marmara University (1981).
strings.highlights.h1.title: Political-system transformation
strings.highlights.h1.text: Moved from premier to president and promoted executive presidential rule.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Cross-regional diplomacy
strings.highlights.h2.text: Long involved in Middle Eastern, European and Black Sea security.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Presidential reelection
strings.timeline.t1.text: Won the 28 May runoff and began another term.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Executive presidency
strings.timeline.t2.text: New system abolished the premiership and concentrated executive powers.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Attempted coup and purges
strings.timeline.t3.text: Government defeated the coup then pursued broad purges, raising rights and rule-of-law concerns.
strings.timeline.t4.title: First elected president
strings.timeline.t4.text: Moved from premier to directly elected president.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Became prime minister
strings.timeline.t6.title: AKP founded
strings.timeline.t6.text: Cofounded the party and became founding chair.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Prison and political ban
strings.timeline.t7.text: Served about four months for incitement linked to a poem recited in a speech.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Istanbul mayor
strings.timeline.t8.text: Won the mayoralty, expanding political influence.
strings.timeline.t9.title: High school completed
strings.timeline.t9.text: Graduated from religious vocational school; pursued youth politics and football.
